text: dsh-sound-notify（DSH 插件，Web 与桌面端）：在 DSH 主机上为任务完成、失败和等待处理播放不同提示音。插件接入宿主事件，在任务结束、模型请求重试、授权请求和提问等待等时机判断应播放的类别，并使用系统音频播放器播放随包提供的声音文件。设置页提供完成、失败、等待三类独立开关，默认开启，修改后实时生效；子代理会话静音，并对连续状态变化作短暂延迟和冷却处理。适合希望离开屏幕或后台运行时仍能听到 DSH 状态变化的用户。macOS 使用 afplay，Linux 使用 paplay；不需要 API Key 或外部账号。

dsh-sound-notify (DSH Web and desktop) plays local sounds when tasks finish, fail, or need attention. It observes host events and offers live switches for completion, failure, and waiting alerts. Subagent sessions stay silent. macOS uses afplay; Linux uses paplay. No API key or account is required.
想让 DSH 任务完成或出错时能响一声提醒。
I want an audible alert when a DSH task finishes or needs my approval.
dsh-sound-notify 的功能「任务状态声音提醒」：根据 DSH 任务完成、失败或等待授权/回答等状态，在运行 DSH 的主机播放对应提示音；三类声音可在设置页分别开关，保存后实时生效。

Sound notifications for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**. When a DSH task finishes, fails, or stops to wait for you, this plugin plays a short sound on the machine running DSH — and gives you a switch for each category.
dsh-sound-notify README · Why：DSH sessions are long-running. Without a sound, you keep alt-tabbing back to the window to check whether the agent is done. This plugin makes "it stopped" audible:

dsh-sound-notify README · Why：| Event | Trigger | Sound |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Task completed | turn ends with `completed` | `sounds/success.aac` |
| Task failed | turn ends with `error` / `max-tokens`, or an API request failed and a retry was scheduled (`llm/retry`) | `sounds/fail.aac` |
| Waiting for you | approval prompt (`approval/asked`), `ask_user_question`, turn aborted / blocked / interrupted | `sounds/stop.aac` |

dsh-sound-notify README · Why：Playback happens in the **DSH host process** with the OS audio player (macOS `afplay`, Linux `paplay`), so it works even when the browser tab is backgrounded, minimized, or closed. The sound plays on the machine that runs DSH.

dsh-sound-notify README · Desktop app (`desktop` profile)：Install it as a **managed third-party plugin** from inside DSH — do not copy files into the profile by hand:

1. Open DSH → left sidebar → **Plugins**.
2. Click **Add plugin**.
3. Paste the repository address: `https://github.com/hifengzy/dsh-sound-notify` (or the release tarball URL, or the npm package name `dsh-sound-notify`).
4. Install, then restart DSH if it asks.

dsh-sound-notify README · Desktop app (`desktop` profile)：The package then appears under **Plugins → Installed plugins** with its own uninstall and update controls. The three sound switches are on its package page: **Plugins → Installed plugins → dsh-sound-notify**.

dsh-sound-notify README · Desktop app (`desktop` profile)：> **Why not copy files?** The Plugins page records a managed install in `$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/package.json` (`dependencies` plus `dsh.profile.bundles`). Files copied into `node_modules` by hand are invisible to the manager — no installed-plugin row, no uninstall button — and the next DSH desktop update prunes them because they are not a declared dependency.

<details>
<summary>Upgrading from the v0.1.0 manual install?</summary>

dsh-sound-notify README · Desktop app (`desktop` profile)：v0.1.0 copied the package into the profile by hand. Run the migration helper, then install through the Plugins page:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/hifengzy/dsh-sound-notify.git
cd dsh-sound-notify
./scripts/migrate-desktop-legacy-install.sh
```

The helper removes the unmanaged copy and mount row while keeping your saved switch values, then prints the managed install steps (paste the repository address into **Add plugin**).

</details>

dsh-sound-notify README · CLI-managed profiles (`web`, `headless`, custom profiles)：Pick whichever source you prefer — all of them are the same plugin:

```bash
dsh-sound-notify README · directly from GitHub (works today)：dsh plugin --profile web add github:hifengzy/dsh-sound-notify

dsh-sound-notify README · prebuilt tarball attached to the latest GitHub Release (works today)：dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/hifengzy/dsh-sound-notify/releases/latest/download/dsh-sound-notify.tgz
section: prebuilt tarball attached to the latest GitHub Release (works today)

text:
dsh-sound-notify README · from npm (published: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-sound-notify)：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-sound-notify
```

Restart the profile's app after installing. `dsh plugin add` installs the package into the profile and appends `dsh-sound-notify` to `dsh.profile.bundles`; the package's own `cordis.patch.yml` mounts the plugin row.

For a custom profile, replace `web` with its name. Check that the plugin composed correctly:bash
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A2 sound-notify
```

dsh-sound-notify README · Settings：**DSH 0.2.x**: **Plugins → Installed plugins → dsh-sound-notify** (the package page, beside its install/enable controls). The values live in the plugin entry's `config` in the profile patch (`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`) and are read live on every notification.

**DSH 0.1.x**: **Settings → Sound notifications** (registered `sound-notify` settings namespace in `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`).

dsh-sound-notify README · Settings：| Switch | Default | When off |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Task completed | on | `success: false` — no completion sound |
| Task failed | on | `failure: false` — no failure/API-error sound |
| Waiting for you | on | `waiting: false` — no approval/question/abort sound |

dsh-sound-notify README · Debugging：The desktop host has no terminal. Set `DSH_SOUND_NOTIFY_LOG` **before launching DSH** to get a line for every decision and playback attempt:

```bash
DSH_SOUND_NOTIFY_LOG=/tmp/dsh-sound-notify.log dsh web
```

```text
2026-10-19T17:21:05.071Z [sound-notify] notifyIdle reason=completed kind=success
2026-10-19T17:21:05.071Z [sound-notify] enabled success = false (config)
2026-10-19T17:21:05.071Z [sound-notify] muted success
```
dsh-sound-notify README · Debugging：Playback failures (missing file, no audio player) are logged too instead of failing silently.

dsh-sound-notify README · Platform support：| Platform | Player | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| macOS | `afplay` | verified |
| Linux | `paplay` (PulseAudio/PipeWire) | requires `paplay` |
| Windows | — | no AAC CLI player; logs a diagnostic and stays silent |

dsh-sound-notify README · Compatibility：| DSH | Settings surface | Install |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0.2.x (current, incl. desktop 0.2.1-rc.3) | Installed-plugin package page over volatile `Config` | app **Add plugin** / `dsh plugin add` / GitHub / tarball |
| 0.1.x | dedicated settings section over a registered namespace | `dsh plugin add` / GitHub |

dsh-sound-notify README · Compatibility：The host half only observes the event bus (`session/event`, `agent/status`, `user-questions/request`) and never edits the session log or influences approval decisions (the question waterfall listener always calls `next()`).

dsh-sound-notify README · Development：```bash
npm install
npm test        # 31 node:test cases
npm run verify  # packaging self-check (manifest, files, AAC magic, client bundle)
npm pack        # prebuilt tarball for releases

CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) runs the test suite on Node 20/22/24, verifies the package, and performs a real install smoke test against the latest published `@deepseek-ai/dsh`: it creates a web profile, installs the packed tarball with `dsh plugin add`, and asserts the plugin composes into the profile tree.

dsh-sound-notify README · Development：Tagging `v*` runs `.github/workflows/release.yml`, which attaches the tarball to a GitHub Release and publishes to npm with provenance (the `NPM_TOKEN` secret is configured). See [docs/PUBLISHING.md](docs/PUBLISHING.md) for the token and catalog-submission details.

dsh-sound-notify README · Community：The plugin is listed in the [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) catalog (`category: notify`), which powers the DSH plugin market (`dshmarket`). Search for “sound” / “notification” on the Plugins page to install it. It is published on npm as [`dsh-sound-notify`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-sound-notify), so the native DSH Discover feed — which only indexes npm packages and is rebuilt from npm daily — picks it up too. Repo topics: `dsh-plugin`, `deepseek-harness`, `dsh`.
